message.content: Lions mate during a brief but intense courtship period that typically lasts only a few days. Male lions form coalitions and compete for dominance; the alpha male will mate with females in estrus, which occurs roughly once every 2–3 weeks. During copulation, the male mounts the female from behind, grasps her with his forepaws, and the mating lasts about 30–60 seconds. After mating, the male may guard the female or leave her to raise the cubs alone.
